title: Legislative districts of Pateros–Taguig
wikitext:
{{Short description|Legislative districts in the Philippines}} {{Politics of the Philippines}} The '''legislative district of Pateros–Taguig''' is the combined representation of the [[Municipalities of the Philippines|independent municipality]] of [[Pateros]] and eastern part of the [[Cities of the Philippines#Independent cities|highly urbanized city]] of [[Taguig]] in the [[Congress of the Philippines]]. The city and municipality are currently represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the Congress through their [[Taguig-Pateros's 1st congressional district|lone congressional district]]. == History == {{further|Legislative districts of Manila|Legislative districts of Rizal|Legislative district of Taguig–Pateros–Muntinlupa|Legislative districts of Taguig}} [[File:Taguig-Pateros Congressional Districts.png|thumb|left|300px|Legislative districts of the combined representation of Taguig–Pateros
{{legend2|#d8dff1|First District}}
{{legend2|#eccfc4|Second District}}]] Areas now under the jurisdiction of Taguig and Pateros were initially represented as part of the [[Manila's at-large congressional district|at-large district]] of the [[Manila (province)|province of Manila]] in the [[Malolos Congress]] from 1898 to 1899. Both towns were later incorporated to the province of [[Rizal (province)|Rizal]], established in 1901, and were represented as part of the [[Rizal's 1st congressional district|first district]] of Rizal from 1907 to 1941 and from 1945 to 1972. During [[World War II]], both towns were represented as part of the [[Legislative districts of Rizal#At-Large (1943–1944)|at-large district]] of Rizal in the [[National Assembly (Second Philippine Republic)|National Assembly of the Second Philippine Republic]] from 1943 to 1944. Taguig and Pateros were separated from Rizal on November 7, 1975, by virtue of Presidential Decree No. 824,{{cite PH act|chamber=PD|number=824|url=http://www.lawphil.net/statutes/presdecs/pd1975/pd_824_1975.html|date=November 7, 1975|access-date=October 10, 2017|title=Creating the Metropolitan Manila and the Metropolitan Manila Commission and for Other Purposes}} and was represented in the [[Interim Batasang Pambansa]] along with other [[Metropolitan Manila]] municipalities and cities as part of [[Interim Batasang Pambansa#Regional Representatives|Region IV]] from 1978 to 1984. Taguig and Pateros were grouped with [[Muntinlupa]] to form [[Legislative district of Taguig–Pateros–Muntinlupa|a single parliamentary district]] which returned [[Legislative district of Taguig-Pateros-Muntinlupa#At-Large (defunct)|one representative]] to the [[Regular Batasang Pambansa]] in [[1984 Philippine parliamentary election|1984]]. Taguig and Pateros formed [[Taguig–Pateros's at-large congressional district|one]] [[House of Representatives of the Philippines#District representation|congressional district]] under the new Constitution{{cite web|title=1987 Constitution of the Philippines - Apportionment Ordinance|url=http://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/constitutions/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines-ordinance/|author=1986 Constitutional Commission|date=February 2, 1987|access-date=October 9, 2017}} proclaimed on February 11, 1987; it elected its member to the restored House of Representatives starting [[1987 Philippine legislative election|that same year]]. The western area of Taguig, coterminous with the Second Councilor District of Taguig (for the purpose of electing municipal, now city, council members), was separated to form a [[Legislative district of Taguig|separate congressional district]] by virtue of Republic Act No. 8487,{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=8487|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legisdocs/ra_10/RA08487.pdf|title=An Act Converting the Municipality of Taguig, Metro Manila, into a Highly Urbanized City to be Known as the City of Taguig, and for Other Purposes|author=Congress of the Philippines|date=February 11, 1998|access-date=October 8, 2017}} the law which converted Taguig into a highly urbanized city. Despite being enacted by Congress on February 11, 1998, the said law only took effect on December 8, 2004, after the [[Commission on Elections (Philippines)|Commission on Elections]] issued a resolution confirming that the affirmative votes for cityhood prevailed in the ballot recount.{{cite news|url=http://www.philstar.com:8080/metro/318481/sc-upholds-taguig-cityhood|work=The Philippine Star|first=Jose Rodel|last=Clapano|date=January 26, 2006|access-date=October 8, 2017|title=SC upholds Taguig cityhood}} This new district first elected its separate representative in the [[2007 Philippine general election|2007 general elections]]. {{further|Makati–Taguig boundary dispute}} There was a boundary dispute over which city has jurisdiction over lands encompassed within the former Fort McKinley U.S. Military Reservation (now [[Fort Bonifacio]] and its surrounding areas). Portions of four of [[Taguig]]'s barangays ([[Fort Bonifacio (barangay)|Fort Bonifacio]], [[Pinagsama]], [[Western Bicutan]], and [[Ususan]]) were claimed by the neighboring city of [[Makati]] as part of its own two barangays ([[Post Proper Northside, Makati|Post Proper Northside]] and [[Post Proper Southside, Makati|Post Proper Southside]]). Residents of areas where Taguig exercise ''de facto'' control vote as part of its [[Taguig–Pateros's 1st congressional district|second congressional district]] except for areas under barangay Ususan, which is part of [[Taguig–Pateros's 1st congressional district|Taguig's 1st district]], while residents of areas where Makati exercises ''de facto'' control vote as part of its [[Makati's 2nd congressional district|second congressional district]]. == Current districts == {{columns-list|colwidth=10em| {{legend|{{party color|Nacionalista Party}}|[[Nacionalista]] (1)|border=1px solid #aaaaaa}} }} {| class="wikitable sortable" style="margin: 1em auto; font-size:100%; line-height:20px; text-align:center" |+Legislative Districts and Congressional Representatives of [[Taguig City]]-[[Pateros]] |- !District ! colspan="3" |Current Representative !
